author: Rabinowitch, Alexander
title: The Bolsheviks Come to Power: The Revolution of 1917 in Petrograd
notes: The standard bottom-up study of Petrograd from July to October, and the work that dismantled the picture of a disciplined conspiracy: on Rabinowitch's evidence the Bolshevik party of 1917 was open, argumentative and internally divided, and won because it was responsive to what the city's workers and soldiers were already demanding. The indispensable corrective to both the Soviet and the coup accounts. Borrow-only; cited without pages.
